title: 第1章 亲事第2章 拖累第3章 联姻
slug: 天道酬勤开局联姻落魄千金
lines: 时值初冬时节，寒风料峭。
整个临江府都笼罩在一层薄薄的灰雾下，即便是艳阳高照的正午时分，灰雾也丝毫未有散去的势头。
此时，位于临江府城东边一隅的沈家，一方静谧别院内。
自认相貌平平的沈长青正死死注视着悬浮在眼前的面板，他的额头早已布满细密的汗水，整副身躯也因过度紧张而变得紧紧绷住。
某一刻，小腹丹田内突然生出了丝丝暖流。
啵~
下一秒，仿佛回应了他的等待，一道微弱的气流声在体内悄然响起，沈长青的气势霎时一涨，再定睛一看，眼前的面板已然发生变化。
【境界：养气境（后期）】
【功法：养气术（圆满）】
【天道酬勤：你只管努力，其他的交给天赋】
“养气境后期，果真没有境关。”
想到此前难以突破的境界如今就这般轻而易举的踏足，沈长青心中就抑制不住的狂喜，“无视境关，水到则渠成，我这天赋果真恐怖如斯！”
一个月前，在被寻回沈家的那个夜晚里，他觉醒了前世宿慧，随后便得到了【天道酬勤】这个天赋。
至于这天赋有什么能力，沈长青已通过前世熟练掌握的能力，成功得到了验证，那就是可以无视任何功法或技能的关卡，只需经验值足够，便可直接突破，一证永证！
“既然功法与技能的关卡能直接突破，那境界之间的境关呢？”
说做就做，经过一个月的勤奋修炼，终于在今日，沈长青得到了他想要的结果，“连境关都可以无视，有此天赋傍身，我必可在修行一途大展拳脚！”
只是，此刻看着眼前面板上养气境的境界，他缓缓吐出一口气，道：“不过，养气境并非修行境界，要想修行，还得加入东漓学宫啊。”
想到这，沈长青当即抬头看向了头顶灰蒙蒙的天穹。
在那高天之上，自遥远东方照来的金色光辉与由西方蔓延而来的黑雾分庭抗礼、各据一方，而在两者之间，则是一片绵延不知多少万里的灰雾缓和区。
当然，沈长青看不清黑雾与金光，更不知晓它们是什么，只知道黑雾能吞噬灵气、污染生灵，其所到之处，便再也无法修行，而金光，则能驱散黑雾。
至于两者之间的灰雾缓和区内，灵气也早已绝迹，根本无法修行。
很不幸，整个临江府，都在这片灰雾缓和区之下。
为了避免被灰雾影响，临江府人人皆会修行以修身养性为主的养气术，于是慢慢的也就有了养气境，而养气境，充其量只能算得上是强身健体的另类武道境界。
临江府的修行境界由低至高实则是聚灵境、化丹境以及神变境三境，每个境界都有前中后期之分。
这黑雾区灰雾缓和区，实则与他前世传说中的绝灵之地或末法之地很类似，在这里是无法修行的，要想修行，就需要到未被污染、尚存灵气的净区中才行，临江府修士人人向往的东漓学宫，便是一方净区。
“不过这东漓学宫一个月的束脩，便是普通人家十年的积蓄，可谓是极其昂贵。”
沈长青收敛气息，对自己施展了一个净尘术后，抬脚便向着院外走去，“还好，沈家不是普通人家。”
content_en:
[Cultivation +1]
[Realm: Nourishing Qi Realm (mid-term: 1999+12000)]
It was early winter, and the wind was freezing cold.
The entire Linjiang Mansion was shrouded in a thin layer of gray fog. Even at noon when the sun was shining brightly, the gray fog showed no signs of dissipating.
At this time, the Shen family, located in the east corner of Linjiang Fucheng, was in a quiet courtyard.
Shen Changqing, who considered himself plain-looking, was staring at the panel suspended in front of him. His forehead was already covered with fine beads of sweat, and his whole body was tense due to excessive tension.
At a certain moment, a trace of warmth suddenly appeared in the dantian of the lower abdomen.
Bo~
The next second, as if in response to his waiting, a faint sound of air flow quietly sounded in the body. Shen Changqing's momentum suddenly rose. When he looked closely, the panel in front of him had changed.
[Realm: Nourishing Qi Realm (Later Stage)]
[Exercise: Nourishing Qi (Perfection)]
[Ability: Broadcasting Gymnastics (Dacheng: 20904000)]
[God rewards those who work hard: Just work hard and leave the rest to your talent]
"In the late stage of Qi-nourishing realm, there really is no realm."
Thinking that the realm that was previously difficult to break through is now so easy, Shen Changqing couldn't suppress the ecstasy in his heart, "Ignore the realm, and it will be successful when it comes. My talent is really terrifying!"
A month ago, on the night when he was found in the Shen family, he awakened the wisdom of his previous life, and then received the talent of [Tiandao rewards those who work hard].
As for the ability of this talent, Shen Changqing has successfully verified it through the ability he mastered in his previous life. That is, he can ignore any level of skills or skills. As long as he has enough experience points, he can directly break through and obtain a permanent certificate!
"Since the barriers between techniques and skills can be broken directly, what about the barriers between realms?"
He did what he said. After a month of diligent practice, today, Shen Changqing finally got the result he wanted. "I can even ignore the obstacles. With this talent, I will definitely be able to make great achievements in my practice!"
However, looking at the Qi-nurturing realm on the panel in front of him, he slowly exhaled and said, "However, the Qi-nurturing realm is not a cultivation realm. If you want to practice, you have to join Dongli Academy."
Thinking of this, Shen Changqing immediately raised his head and looked at the gray sky above his head.
High in the sky, the golden light shining from the far east and the black mist spreading from the west compete with each other, and between the two, there is a gray mist relaxation zone that stretches for countless thousands of miles.
Of course, Shen Changqing couldn't see the black mist and golden light clearly, let alone what they were. He only knew that the black mist could swallow spiritual energy and pollute living beings. Wherever it went, it would no longer be possible to practice, while the golden light could dispel the black mist.
As for the gray fog relaxation zone between the two, the spiritual energy has long since disappeared, making it impossible to practice at all.
Unfortunately, the entire Linjiang Mansion is under this gray fog mitigation zone.
In order to avoid being affected by the gray fog, everyone in Linjiang Prefecture would practice Qi-nourishing techniques that focused on cultivating one's body and mind, and gradually developed a Qi-nourishing realm, which at best could only be regarded as an alternative martial arts realm to strengthen the body.
From low to high, the cultivation realms of Linjiang Mansion are actually three realms: the Spirit Gathering Realm, the Alchemy Transformation Realm and the Divine Transformation Realm. Each realm can be divided into early, middle and late stages.
This black fog area and gray mist alleviation area are actually very similar to the legendary land of extraordinary spirits or the land of the end of law in his previous life. It is impossible to practice here. If you want to practice, you need to go to a pure area that is not polluted and still has spiritual energy. The Dongli Academy that everyone in Linjiang Prefecture longs for is a pure area.
"However, one month of cultivation in Dongli Academy is equivalent to ten years of savings of an ordinary family. It can be said to be extremely expensive."
Shen Changqing restrained his breath, performed a cleansing operation on himself, and walked out of the hospital, "Fortunately, the Shen family is not an ordinary family."
